messages:
maya: :rotating_light: Noticing spikes of SSE partial outputs + client reconnect loops from NA customers since ~08:12 UTC. Tickets show last chunk truncated and client sees 200 then immediate connection close.

samir: Which frontends are affected? Any correlation with specific models or routes?

maya: Mostly /v1/stream and /v1/chat/stream. Seems heavier on long-lived streams (>=30s). No single model stands out yet, but we have repeated mentions of small tokens getting cut off.

john: Checked gateway logs — we see `ERR_SSE_FRAG` on router-12 and router-14 around 08:11-08:16 UTC. Trace id starts with ec3f*. Sample:
```
[2026-03-10T08:13:02Z] router-12 conn=4329 trace=ec3f9a... level=error msg="sse: fragmented payload, client reset" upstream=frontend-pool-7
[2026-03-10T08:13:02Z] router-12 conn=4329 upstream_err=write failed: broken pipe
```

lisa: Also seeing `prefix-cache miss -> fallthrough` warnings on the KV cache node. Could be KV eviction thrash and timing causing partial response assembly.

samir: Two hypotheses: (1) proxy or frontend prematurely closes the chunked connection on certain interleavings, (2) KV cache eviction leaves incomplete prefix consumption leading to truncated chunk.

maya: Repro steps I used (from support):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/chat/stream" -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"long test"}] }'
```
Result: initial events start, then after ~26s we get `event: error` followed by connection close.

support-bot: Customers affected: acct_alpha, acct_beta, acct_gamma. Support tickets opened: INC-4981, INC-4983, INC-4990. Notified customer success.

john: I rotated router-12 out of rotation at 08:25 UTC for a quick confirmation — partials dropped by ~80% for traffic routed away.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-RED-2026-03-10-1768001234. Priority: P2. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/ops/runbooks/sse-degradation

lisa: Quick mitigation options: (A) disable prefix KV caching on affected frontends (reduces speed but may stop truncation), (B) failover NA canonical traffic to eu-west for user sessions that tolerate slight latency bump, (C) short-term model fallback to stateless smaller model variant that avoids prefix cache logic.

samir: I can patch a guard in frontend to avoid early `Connection: close` on partial flushes — small change, low-risk. If we do (A) + guard it should be resolved.

maya: Can you scope the guard change? ETA?

samir: Patch + canary deploy in 30m, full rollout in ~2h if canary looks good. Will also add additional logging for `sse_fragment_seq` and preserve last-kv-hash to detect the exact mismatch window.

john: I'll stand up temporary route rule to route NA streaming traffic to eu-west for non-enterprise customers — will toggle in console and monitor error rate.

maya: Customer comms: I'll post a status update to status.redwood.com with note about partial SSE interruptions in NA, mitigation in progress, and recommended workaround (short-term polling fallback or retry logic client-side).

support-bot: Draft update for customers: "We are investigating intermittent SSE truncation and reconnects affecting streaming responses in our NA region. We have mitigations in progress and will provide ETA within 2 hours. If you need immediate relief, use the non-streaming endpoint or route to eu-west."

lisa: Observability notes: add a dashboard for `sse.partial_frames` + `router.stream_errors` per router. We'll need 1h to ship a quick dashboard and alert threshold.

maya: Action items:
- samir: deploy guard patch canary (30m) -> full rollout (2h)
- john: enable NA->EU failover rule for non-enterprise (immediate)
- lisa: disable prefix cache on rotated routers and instrument counters (15m)
- support: update impacted customers and attach repro steps (now)

samir: Starting canary deploy now against router-13. Monitoring logs.

john: NA->EU failover enabled at 08:40 UTC for ~20% traffic. Early telemetry shows 60% reduction in partials for routed sessions.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow change control for routing rule. Change ID CHG-7765.

maya: Good progress. Keep thread for postmortem notes. I'll escalate to on-call manager for SLA review if we see continued customer impact after rollout. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status -> Mitigated (partial). Next update scheduled in 45m.

lisa: Postmortem owners: lisa (lead), samir (runtime), john (routing). Will collect logs and create RCA doc after stabilization.

support-bot: Updated tickets with mitigation steps and ETA. Will reach out to top impacted customers directly.

samir: Canary looks clean; pushing full rollout now.

maya: Closing loop: full rollout completed at 09:58 UTC, error rates returned to baseline by ~10:05 UTC. Postmortem assigned.

john: Notes for RCA: investigate KV eviction policy under high-concurrency SSE, check interplay between keepalive timers and frontend flush windows, evaluate option to make prefix cache optional per route.

lisa: I'll create the postmortem doc and link to this thread. Thanks team.
